evidence: Opened Configure Fields dialog; existing fields Task Name(Text), Priority(Number), Due Date(Date), Completed(Checkbox); added new field "Notes" with type Text via New field name box + Add button; it appeared as new column in table.
Clicked Add Entry, filled form, submitted; new row "QA Test Entry" appeared in table, entry count went from 5 to 6.

New entry saved with Task Name="QA Test Entry" (text), Priority=5 (number), Due Date=Dec 25, 2026 (date), Completed=checked (lucide-check icon with text-success class confirms checkbox true), Notes="Test notes value" (text). All field types saved and displayed correctly.
Checked entries render a green "check" icon (lucide-check, text-success class); unchecked entries render an "x" icon (lucide-x, text-muted-foreground class). Clearly visually distinguishable.

issue: Missing required-field validation on Add Entry
actual: Opened Add Entry dialog, left Task Name (a required text field) empty, and submitted. The app accepted the submission and added a new row with an empty Task Name and empty Notes value (Priority defaulted to 0, Due Date defaulted to today). Entry count increased from 6 to 7. Expected: entry should not be addable when a defined field is left blank/undefined.

Clicked the delete (trash) icon button on a table row once; the entry was immediately removed from the table (entry count dropped from 7 to 6) with no confirmation prompt, dialog, or undo option shown at any point.

evidence: Priority field is a native number input (input[type=number]). Typing "abc" left the value unchanged; typing "12a3b" resulted in value "0123" (only digit characters 1,2,3 accepted; letters a,b silently rejected by the browser-native numeric input). Non-numeric characters cannot be entered.

Due Date field is a native date input (input[type=date]). Setting an invalid date string "2026-13-45" (month 13, day 45) resulted in the field value becoming empty (rejected), confirming the browser-native date input does not accept invalid calendar dates.

Clicked "Cards" button; view switched from table to a card grid layout showing all 6 entries as individual cards with field labels (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) and values. Clicking "Table" (verified below) returns to table layout.

Compared all 6 entries between Table view and Card view: values for Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed, and Notes match exactly in both views (e.g., "QA Test Entry" / 5 / Dec 25, 2026 / Yes / Test notes value appears identically in both). No data missing or truncated in either view.

Card view: each field is labeled by name (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) and accompanied by a type-specific icon (lucide-hash for Number, lucide-calendar for Date, check/x icon for Checkbox). Table view: column headers show field names, and cell rendering differs by type (numbers rendered in monospace font, dates formatted as "MMM D, YYYY", checkboxes rendered as check/x icons). Configure Fields dialog explicitly labels each field's type (Text/Number/Date/Checkbox) via a dropdown next to its name.
Clicked "Priority" column header in table view; entries reordered ascending by Priority (1,1,2,2,3,5). Clicking again toggled to descending (5,3,2,2,1,1). Sort by field works correctly.

After sorting table by Priority ascending, all 6 entries remained present with unchanged field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Notes) for each row — only order changed, no data lost or modified.

Clicking the Priority column header immediately re-rendered the table in the new sort order (ascending then descending) within the same tool call/response cycle, with no perceptible delay or need for manual refresh.

Typed "marketing" into the "Search entries..." search box; the table immediately narrowed from 6 entries to 1 matching entry ("Review marketing materials"), with status text updating to '1 entry matching "marketing"'. Clearing search (via the clear "x" button) restored all entries.

actual: Explored the entire UI (toolbar, Sort menu, column header clicks/right-clicks, Configure Fields dialog) and inspected the DOM/HTML source for any filter control or the word "filter"/"criteria"/"facet"/"where" — none exists. The Sort menu only offers sort-by-field and "Clear sort"; the search box performs full-text search (covered separately by IX-17) but does not support field-specific criteria filtering (e.g. Priority > 2, Completed = true, date range). There is no way to apply a filter to show only entries meeting specified criteria.

issue: No filter feature implemented (dependent on FT-6)
actual: Since no filter feature exists in the application (confirmed via UI exploration and DOM inspection, see FT-6), filter accuracy for including/excluding entries per criteria cannot be verified — there is no mechanism to apply such filters at all.

evidence: Table view: used the drag-handle button's keyboard interaction (Space to pick up, ArrowUp x5, Space to drop) to move "QA Test Entry" from last position to first; resulting order matched the manual operation exactly. Card view: moved "Design new landing page" from position 1 to position 5 via drag handle (Space, ArrowDown x5, Space); resulting order (Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design, QA) exactly matched the manual reorder performed.
